mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is active whenever the rate trend is downward.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 7.0% for three consecutive months, it signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 7.0%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenue expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a rise in the federal funds rate above 2.0% compresses liquidity and increases discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly growth rate in real GDP above 2.0% indicates robust economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index exceeds 235.0, it signals accelerating inflation that erodes real corporate profits and triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 235.0, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in employment (PAYEMS) and fall in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply shock recovery phase, a decline in industrial production below 95.0 signals an impending rebound in manufacturing activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
